component.name: DealDrop
component.summary: Game sale, giveaway and wishlist notifier

description.p: DealDrop notifies you when Steam sales start, when free games drop on Epic, Steam and GOG, and when games on your wishlists go on sale. It runs in your system tray; no API keys, no telemetry.

ul.li: Free games from Epic, Steam and GOG, de-duplicated across sources
Steam sale alerts, with a heads-up the day before a sale starts
Store sales from Steam, GOG and Epic Games
Hot deals across 30+ stores via CheapShark, with a lowest-ever badge
Wishlists from Steam, GOG and Epic, with price targets
Hide games, themes, and a seasonal theme during Steam sales
